findings.location: translation.html — paragraph mentioning The Martyr’s Mirror
findings.source_quote: I ordered a copy of The Martyr’s Mirror and was astounded when I read about these people who lived like the disciples.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) translate the book title into French (La Glace des Martyrs or the established French title if one exists) while keeping the original in italics, or (b) mark it clearly as a foreign-title proper name by keeping it in italics but optionally adding a brief French explanatory phrase. Example: « J'ai commandé un exemplaire de The Martyr’s Mirror (Le Miroir des martyrs) » — preserve the HTML tags exactly as in the translation.
findings.translation_quote: J'ai commandé un exemplaire de The Martyr’s Mirror et j'ai été stupéfait quand j'ai lu ces personnes qui vivaient comme les disciples.
